name: book-buddy
description: A conversational AI agent, reached through the standard /chat interface via the Try it test app, that helps team members find books in the shared library. It recommends books by genre or author, reports availability, and proactively surfaces related catalogue titles — restricted to the searchBooks and getBook tools on library-service, so it can never invent a title outside the catalogue. It holds no business data of its own beyond its own conversation history.

dependencies.name: library-service
dependencies.description: Looks up books by genre/author and by id to answer questions, check availability, and surface related books — its only two allowed tools.
